main_title: The Flight of the Condor and the Eagle
main_sub: The Christian cross as a key to transcend matter and space-time
header_desc: The Gnostic gospels, written almost two thousand years ago, hold the solution to one of the greatest enigmas of modern physics: quantum gravity. In this framework, consciousness manifests through two fundamental states —the spiritual |ONE⟩ and the material |EGO⟩—. Therefore, the Primordial Consciousness calls us to ignite the inner spark by perceiving the ONE ❤️ to finally free ourselves from the illusion of the Demiurge 🧠
left_title: The Awakening of Sophia: From the Prison of Yaldabaoth to the Kingdom of Light
left_body: In general relativity, matter tells space-time how to curve, and space-time tells matter how to move. Similarly, the ego exerts its own gravity: its density deforms your inner fabric and weaves the material-temporal illusion of the psyche 🧠. This grants us a free will of perception that can be mathematically formalized as an inner product ⟨ONE | EGO ⟩. Thus, only through the wisdom of Sophia is it possible to transcend that curvature and return to the divine and timeless plane of the cosmos, in the purity of the pneuma ❤️. In this light, the statement "the Father and I are one" is a call to dissolve the "false self" to return to the Kingdom of pure light where the Invisible Father dwells.
universe_light_text: Understanding that death is not an absolute end, but a transformation frees us from ignorance. In the right hemisphere, our pneuma resides in the timeless and divine plane, the high-frequency dimension | 999⟩. There lies the land of union and freedom (The Great Homeland).
center_text: The Kingdom of God is within you and is outside of you (Gospel of Thomas, Saying 3). Pistis Sophia represents the right hemisphere, while the demiurge Yaldabaoth embodies the left, thus revealing the fundamental duality of human consciousness.
universe_mat_text: The human body is composed of carbon-12 (6p^+, 6e^-, 6n^0). In the left hemisphere lies the temporal and material plane, the low-frequency dimension | 666⟩. Gravitational force drags us to a place where: <q>war is peace, freedom is slavery, and ignorance is strength</q> (1984).
final_quote: When the Eagle of the North and the Condor of the South fly together in the same sky, Mother Earth will awaken and humanity will heal.
p2_sub: Condor and Eagle: A journey through gnosis and physics
cap1_title: Chapter 1: The Prophecy of the Condor and the Eagle footnotesize color{golddark}(00:10 -- 01:07)
cap1_desc: Premise and integration framework: the reconciliation between the intuitive wisdom of the South (the heart, ancestral knowledge, and spirit) and the technological development of the North (reason, science, and mind). The call for balance to initiate the evolutionary awakening and transcend the state of duality.
cap2_title: Chapter 2: Quantum Gravity and the Illusion of Time (01:13 -- 02:42)
cap2_desc: The fundamental clash of theoretical physics: General Relativity vs. Quantum Mechanics. Why the laws of Newton and Maxwell do not distinguish between past and future, Einstein's breakdown of simultaneity, and the dissolution of linear time as a neural reconstruction of memory.
cap3_desc: The conceptual ensemble Faggin--Segarra: the body as a vehicle operated by a conscious quantum field outside of space-time, where qualia reside. Consciousness does not emerge from the brain but precedes it, converging with the First Consciousness and the Timeless Intelligent Designer.
cap4_desc: The discovery of Nag Hammadi (1945) and the Coptic codices: the material cosmos conceived not as home, but as the confinement of the soul. The teaching of the Gospel of Thomas (Logion 3): Jesus did not come to found a religion of dogmas, but to free the inner spark from the prison of the Demiurge through remembrance (gnosis).
cap5_title: Chapter 5: The Kingdom of Light and the Prison of the Demiurge (08:43 -- 10:16)
cap5_desc: The Demiurge Yaldabaoth —also known as the great architect of matter— is the creator of the sensible world, an egocentric god ignorant of true divinity. On the other hand, Sophia lies captive in the density of matter, awaiting the spark of awakening.
cap6_title: Chapter 6: The Dajjal and the Universal Hemispheres (10:23 -- 14:38)
cap6_desc: Comparative eschatology and perceptual distortion: the figure of the Dajjal and the visual trick of the inverted paradise (the river and the fire). The mechanism of Orwellian doublethink (1984) as cognitive prison of the ego, against the revolutionary message of Jesus that dismantles the imperial system of slavery.
cap7_title: Chapter 7: Reflections on Our Place in the Cosmos (14:40 -- 16:30)
cap7_desc: The end, the great paradox reduces to this: in the immensity of the cosmos —with its more than two trillion galaxies— this is where the phrase of Jesus resonates most strongly: “The Father and I are one.” Could there have been a hidden message about the profound bond between humanity and the cosmos?
sagan_quote: <q>The idea that God is a white man, taller than normal, with a flaming beard, sitting in heaven and counting the fall of every sparrow, is ridiculous. But if by God one understands the set of physical laws that govern the universe, then clearly such a God exists. However, this God is emotionally unsatisfying... it doesn't make much sense to pray to the law of gravity</q>
